name: [🍀2X LUCK] Don't Steal the Forsakens!
desc:
💀 Don't Steal the Forsaken! 💀

Shh… 🤫 Don’t wake the forsakens! Sneak through the cursed ruins and steal forbidden relics while they slumber in the dark. 😴
But beware — once they awaken, there’s no escape from their wrath. 🏃‍♂️🔥

💰 Gather dark treasures and rise as the most feared relic thief in the forsaken world!
⚡ Earn cash even while you’re offline — the darkness never rests. 🕯️
🌒 Unlock ancient curses, awaken mythic beings, and build your own hall of the forsaken.
